subject.title: improve(ui): remove the Context Profile presets card from Quick Settings

question: Should Quick Settings remove the Context Profile presets entirely and keep the three context tuning keys only in Advanced settings/openclaw.json, with a generic pending-changes bar replacing the old footer?
rationale: The PR removes an existing visible Simple Settings workflow and has the protected `maintainer` label, so automation should not make the final product acceptance decision.

options.title: Approve the removal
options.body: Merge the PR after normal exact-head review because it preserves config keys and replaces the needed commit controls with a generic pending bar.

options.title: Keep a reduced preset surface
options.body: Ask for a smaller or collapsed Context Profile affordance if maintainers still want presets visible in Simple settings.

options.title: Reject this direction
options.body: Close or revise the linked cleanup request if the one-click preset workflow should remain a first-class Quick Settings feature.

recommendation.title: Approve the removal
recommendation.body: Merge the PR after normal exact-head review because it preserves config keys and replaces the needed commit controls with a generic pending bar.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is listed as a maintainer and has the strongest recent history on the Settings declutter path this PR continues.
